name: Shelley
source:
Shelley has always been one of the lads. She's down to get dirty and messy, and isn't afraid to take risks. Shelley's the kind of shelf who grew up playing sports, and was always tougher than the rest of her friend group, but has a heart of gold. Shelley is a real pal, and probably one of the best you'll ever find. She spends most of her time being so supporting and lifting others up, and will always have your back. Does it come off as being high-strung sometimes? Sure, but that might be due to a bracket-mounting problem than anything else.
Likes: Stability
Dislikes: Volume Control

[From the in-game Date-a-dex]
